name: The Veil-Reaching
description: A dangerous art of reaching through the fraying Veil to borrow power from the chaotic dream-realm, risking one's sanity and reality itself.
rules: Temporarily impose dream-logic on a small area of reality, altering physical laws for moments
Summon ephemeral constructs from dream-stuff that obey simple commands before dissolving
Create temporary 'anchors' that briefly stabilize reality against dream-bleed in a localized area
limitations: Cannot create permanent change — all effects unravel completely when the power ends
Cannot affect the dead or interact with souls — only the living and the dreaming
Cannot reverse time or see the future — dream-stuff is chaotic and non-linear
Cannot protect the caster's own mind from the dream-realm's psychic feedback
costs: Each use leaves permanent 'dream-scars' on the practitioner's psyche, accumulating into madness
Reality around the practitioner becomes increasingly unstable, attracting more dream-bleed
Prolonged use causes permanent sleep deprivation — the dream-realm claims part of their rest
Overuse can create temporary reality tears that release hostile dream-entities
technology_level: Early Renaissance with technology focused on reality-stabilization; magic is feared and mostly forbidden outside sanctioned Anchorhold rituals
origin: The fraying Veil between waking reality and the chaotic realm of dreams that bleeds through each dawn
practitioners: Desperate 'Veil-Reachers' who learn through dangerous, often self-destructive experimentation; extremely rare (1 in 50,000) and usually shunned
original_description: A dangerous art of reaching through the fraying Veil to borrow power from the chaotic dream-realm, risking one's sanity and reality itself.
